Scan the QR code with the Famn app to approve this pairing.

To approve manually instead, open the Famn app, go to **Settings > Spaces > Approve device** and enter:

- Pairing ID: `{pairing_id}`
- Code: `{code}`

The code expires after 5 minutes.
